app.title: Claude Code Remote
app.footer: Claude Code Remote for Home Assistant (unofficial)
common.saved_restart: Saved. Restart Remote Control to apply it.
common.csrf: Invalid CSRF token. Reload the page.
lang.title: Language
lang.hint: Language of this web interface. If CLAUDE.md still has the default text, it is switched to the new language too.
auth.first_html: First access: the password is admin. You will be asked to change it afterwards.
auth.must_change: You must change the initial password before continuing.
auth.cur_wrong: The current password is not correct.
auth.min8: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
auth.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
dash.backup_note_html: Important: Claude can change your Home Assistant configuration. Before asking it for changes, make a backup from Home Assistant (in the HA menu: Settings → System → Backups) or ask Claude to make one. Claude will also remind you before important changes.
dash.perm_note_html: Too many questions? If Claude asks for permission too often (for example, from your phone), change the permission mode in the Claude tab → Remote Control and restart Remote Control.
dash.ssh_text_html: With SSH, Claude can also see the HA containers (sudo docker ps, Zigbee2MQTT and Mosquitto logs…). Without SSH everything else works the same.
login.title: Log in
login.step2: Open the link, sign in with your claude.ai account and authorize it.
login.step3: Copy the code shown on the page and paste it here.
login.incomplete: The login was not completed. Check the output and try again.
claude.session_hint: Remote Control needs a full login with a claude.ai account (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise). An API key does not work. The login is stored in the add-on folder and survives updates.
rc.config_hint: How the service that connects this Claude to claude.ai/code and the app is started.
rc.spawn_same_dir: same-dir: all sessions in the working folder
cc.from_image: the one bundled with the add-on
cc.update_hint: Downloads the latest version of Claude Code (about 300 MB, it can take a minute) without rebuilding the add-on. If Remote Control is running, it is restarted and open sessions are closed.
cc.already_latest: You already have the latest version ({v}).
cc.not_installed: Claude Code is not installed yet. {state}
cc.state_installing: It is being downloaded now (first start, about 300 MB). This page will work once it finishes.
cc.state_error: The download failed and will be retried in a few minutes: {err}
claudemd.hint_html: Instructions Claude reads at the start of every session (file /config/workspace/CLAUDE.md). Tell it about your home: important entities, things that must never be touched…
claudemd.saved: CLAUDE.md saved. It applies to new sessions.
claudemd.restored: CLAUDE.md restored to the default text.
ha.hint: By default the add-on uses the Supervisor's internal token: you do not need to create any token. Fill this in only if you want another server or your own long-lived token.
ha.token_saved: (one is saved; leave empty to keep it)
ha.saved: Saved. Restart Remote Control so new sessions use it.
ssh.title: SSH to the "Advanced SSH & Web Terminal" add-on
ssh.optional: Optional. Lets Claude see the containers of Home Assistant and its add-ons (status, Zigbee2MQTT and Mosquitto logs…). Without SSH, Claude works the same but without this access.
ssh.hostkey_changed_html: The SSH server key has changed. This happens when the SSH add-on is reinstalled or restored. If that is the case, forget the old key and try again: the new one will be saved.
ssh.protection_html: For Claude to see the containers (docker), disable Protection mode on the SSH add-on page (open it) and restart it.
ssh.auto_hostkey: Automatically update the SSH server key
ssh.auto_hostkey_hint_html: When the SSH add-on is reinstalled or restored, its key changes. With this option the new one is accepted automatically. Untick it if you prefer the connection to stop so you can decide whether the new key can be trusted (the Forget the server key button then appears).
ssh.import_label: OpenSSH private key (or one-line base64), without passphrase
ssh.no_key_yet: There is no SSH key yet.
ssh.hostkey_changed_short: the server key has changed (Host key verification failed).
ssh.forgotten: Server key forgotten. Test the connection: the new one will be saved.
ssh.replaced_suffix: In the SSH add-on the old key has been replaced by the new one: press Connect automatically to apply it.
ssh.not_privkey: This does not look like an OpenSSH private key (it must start with -----BEGIN).
ssh.invalid_key: Invalid key (or passphrase-protected, which is not supported): {err}
ssh.err_no_key: there is no SSH key yet
ssh.err_not_installed: the Advanced SSH & Web Terminal add-on is not installed
ssh.dismissed: OK. You can set up SSH whenever you want in the Home Assistant tab.
sshc.core_only_html: You have Terminal & SSH, but it does not give access to the containers. That needs Advanced SSH & Web Terminal (both can be installed).
sshc.missing_html: This needs the Advanced SSH & Web Terminal add-on, which is not installed.
sshc.install_hint: Install it (no configuration needed) and come back to this page: the button to connect it will appear.
sshc.auto_restart_html: It configures itself: this add-on's key is added to Advanced SSH & Web Terminal and it is restarted.
sshc.auto_start_html: It configures itself: this add-on's key is added to Advanced SSH & Web Terminal and it is started.
sshc.manual: I prefer to do it by hand
sshsetup.step1_html: Start the Advanced SSH & Web Terminal add-on and open its terminal (Open web UI).
sshsetup.step2: Paste these commands and press Enter. They already contain this add-on's public key.
sshsetup.hint_html: The second part stores the key in the SSH add-on options so it is not lost when it restarts. You can also do it by hand: in Home Assistant, Settings → Apps → SSH → Configuration → authorized_keys, add the line starting with ssh-ed25519, save and restart.
env.title: Environment variables for Claude
env.hint_html: One per line, NAME=value (e.g. GH_TOKEN=…). New sessions see them after restarting Remote Control. Variables that would break the login (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc.) are not accepted.
env.saved: Saved.{ignored} Restart Remote Control to apply it.
backup.download_warn: The file contains secrets (claude.ai login, private SSH key, tokens). Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.restore_warn_html: Warning: the current configuration (password, claude.ai login, SSH keys, CLAUDE.md and variables) will be lost and replaced by the one in the backup. If you want to keep it, download a backup first.
backup.reset_text_html: Logs out of claude.ai and deletes the whole configuration: web password, SSH keys, CLAUDE.md, variables and Claude history. The add-on is left as freshly installed (password admin).
backup.reset_warn: This cannot be undone. Download a backup first if you want.
backup.restored: {n} items restored. Log in again (the password may have changed).
backup.reset_done: Everything deleted. The password is 'admin' again.
js.confirm_logout: Are you sure you want to log out?
js.confirm_restore: The current configuration will be lost and replaced by the one in the backup. Continue?
js.confirm_claude_logout: Are you sure? Remote Control will stop.
js.confirm_cc_update: Update Claude Code? If Remote Control is running, it will be restarted.
js.confirm_cc_undo: Go back to the add-on version? If Remote Control is running, it will be restarted.
js.confirm_claudemd_reset: Replace the content with the default text?
js.confirm_ssh_restart: The SSH add-on will restart and any open terminal sessions will be closed. Continue?
js.confirm_forget_hostkey: Forget the SSH server key? The one it presents will be saved on the next connection.
js.confirm_new_key: Replace the current key? The old public key will stop working.
js.confirm_rc_stop: Stop Remote Control? Open sessions will be closed.
js.ex_installing: Downloading Claude Code (first start, about 300 MB). It can take a few minutes; this page updates by itself.
js.ex_install_error: Could not download Claude Code. It will be retried in a few minutes.
js.ex_no_auth: Remote Control cannot start until you connect a claude.ai account. Do it below; when done, it will start by itself.
js.ex_running: Running. Open claude.ai/code or the Claude app: the session shows up as {session}.
js.ex_restarting: Remote Control stopped and will start again by itself in {n} s.
js.ex_stopped: Remote Control is stopped. Press Start to start it.
js.lg_waiting_code: Open the link and paste the code.
